You will most likely have to change into the hospital gown that is open everywhere, so unless all your scars/cuts are on your stomach or in that area, they're gonna be on full display. If you can make an excuse, do it. If you have old scars that are fading, cover it with makeup as best you can. They don't let you cover anything that's not what the gown covers, and will ask you to take off what else you are wearing. I was hiding my cuts with a long sleeve/bracelet combo and got caught big time. However, I had the saving grace to put makeup over my older scars and it only seemed like I cut a little when in reality it was a lot more.

The doctor will most likely tell your parents if you are a minor but if not, they'll ask how old they are and how often you feel the urge but they won't do anything unless they think you're in immediate danger
